in_marathi.name: Yayivansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yayivansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Yayivansh is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a combination of two words – Yaji (God) and Van (descendant). The name signifies a God's descendant or a divine being. It is a powerful and auspicious name bestowed upon children born in Hindu families.
